snippet.title: VILLAINY Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
VILLAINY is a new fantasy social deduction game for 4-10 players. It features many classes (roles) where you can out smart your opponents. You role doesn't decide if you are a VILLAIN or a HERO, so making the right calls and discovering peoples true motives is a true challenge.

Out on steam now!
